notes.title: Small update!
notes.content:
By request, the graphical settings (resolution and fullscreen) are now saved after you exit the options screen and loaded when the game starts. 

Hopefully I didn't break anything in the process here but if I did, email me at support@taraxippus.com

Thanks!

notes.title: Update released
notes.content: Someone asked me to implement an auto-save and I did. In Story Mode, it will auto-save your coin count, what stage you're on, which and how many players you're using. The "CONTINUE" option should show up once you complete a stage and should show up as long as you have a save file. It's pretty bare bones but if you have any issues, email me at support@taraxippus.com. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Patch released!
notes.content: There was an issue with non-US players having a crash after the third stage. This was due to a parsing issue with double values. It should be fixed now but let me know support@taraxippus.com
